featured_reviews.name: Milind Vartak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was down for a day trip to Mumbai and chanced upon Oceanic at Chembur. A Mangalorean restaurant, so its very difficult to go wrong!

I live at Pune and avoid seafood there. But Mumbai is home to the freshest and the best - and so I ordered Prawn Gassi and Neer Dosa and a chilled Fresh Lime Soda..

Prior to settling for this, I had asked the server if I should also order a starter. He advised me against as what I was ordering was enough. Mighty honest of him!

Well, the Prawn Gassi was simply divine. And when combined with Neer Dosa it took the entire combo to a fantastically heavenly level..

The quantity was outstanding and I had to order another round of Neer Dosas and yet another Fresh Lime Soda to polish off the Prawn Gassi!

The decor was simple and the restaurant was super clean 👌
Mood was super and chilled by the AC!
Staff were courteous and helpful...

I hardly visit Mumbai nowadays, but next trip I will again choose to come here to try out newer dishes from their mouth-watering menu.

Rs. 1050/- was bill. And that was very well spent amount 😀

featured_reviews.name: Yashank Suvarna
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place yesterday and really enjoyed the overall experience. If you’re someone who loves authentic Maharashtrian cuisine, especially seafood, this place is definitely worth trying. The food quality was genuinely very good and the flavors felt authentic and fresh.

What stood out the most for me was the ambience, the friendliness of the staff, and the overall service. The staff was polite, welcoming, and attentive throughout the visit.

That said, there are a few areas where the restaurant can improve. Firstly, they should consider replacing the plastic glasses with real glass ones, as the current ones had turned yellow over time. Also, the glass served with my cold drink had a noticeable essence/smell of solkadhi, which made the drink feel slightly oily or buttery in taste, I preferred drinking directly through the bottle.

Another thing was the waiting time for the Komdi Vade. The restaurant wasn’t particularly crowded when I visited, but the dish still took around 40 minutes. When I followed up on the order, the waiter went into the kitchen and brought it out within a minute. Since the vade were hot, I’m not sure whether the food had been waiting in the kitchen already or if it was simply a coincidence that it got ready right after I asked.

Overall, despite a few shortcomings, the food and hospitality made the visit enjoyable. A solid 4-star experience.

featured_reviews.name: Kiran More
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Varasaa and had an absolutely wonderful experience. If you love authentic Maharashtrian flavors, especially seafood, chicken and mutton thali, this place is a must-visit.

The seafood was exceptionally fresh and perfectly cooked. The chicken and mutton thali were generous in portion and rich in flavor. The highlight for me was the Kala Masala Kalvan – beautifully spiced, aromatic, and deeply authentic. You can truly taste the traditional Maharashtrian touch in every bite.

The staff were polite, attentive, and very welcoming. Service was quick and well-organized. The atmosphere was clean, comfortable, and family-friendly, making it ideal for both casual dining and family outings.

featured_reviews.name: Sherry Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
A delightful Maharashtrian dining experience with standout service! During our recent visit to Varasaa Restaurant in Chembur, we were pleasantly impressed by the warm and welcoming service, especially by our waiter Deepu. He was attentive, polite, and ensured our orders arrived promptly, his hospitality genuinely enhanced our meal.

The restaurant itself is comfortable and well-spaced, making it a great spot for casual lunches or dinners with family and friends.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Raundal

featured_reviews.name: Prasad Parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
okan Delite is probably one of the best place for seafood lovers in Mumbai.
Truly authentic taste with best in class hygiene..

Now coming to the delicious taste...

Most of the dishes are cooked in earthen pots which has its own unique taste and flavour.

The entire range of seafood is freshly cooked n served as per the order.

One can identify and differentiate the uniqueness in taste of each and every menu . Dry masala items and gravies...

Our family had tried and tasted almost the entire menu card....since last 6 months...

Prawns masala , "prawns dry"
Prawns tawa fry.. Pomfret fry , Surmai fry.. Dry Chicken
the entire range is superb...especially when it comes with Jowar and Bajara Roti /Bhakari...

The cooking responsibilities are shouldered by maharashtrian lady Cook....who carefully preserve the conventional Konkani taste.

Now coming to the pocket.yes here also Kokan delite is light on your pocket.
The entire menu range is kept below 500 bucks.
That's really awesome.

Best quality hygienic seafood at such a affordable price....amazing...

"Kokan delite" a true Pioneers in conventional sea foods in Mumbai....
5 Stars..for Taste, hygiene,
and Solcurry.. :)

Happy healthy eating...Enjoy...

featured_reviews.name: Kaustubh Shidhaye
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the very few authentic konkan style non vegetarian food available in the Chembur camp area. The preparation is great and taste is really good.

1. The seafood served here was fresh. I had surmai and it was really good. The chef's were polite and prepare it as per our requirement if required. (Some ppl require xtra spicy, while some do not)
2. The chicken biryani was tasty and it was available on Wednesday and Sundays. Chef's informed that they do not use artificial flavours in rice which I think makes the whole thing more likeable.
3. Chicken masala tasted great along with rice bhakri. Chicken dishes with vade is also good option.
4. To finish your dinner you can have solkadi which is not a commonly available drink in other restaurants.
5. Cleanliness/hygiene maintained was very good and the live kitchen allows you to see it for urself.
6. The place is takeaway (however home delivery is available). So you can order in advance and just collect it after sometime.
7. Prices are really reasonable compared to others.

Happy Dining...

featured_reviews.name: Savita Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered Sahara Special Chicken Kepsa Rice from Sahara Restaurant at night. We ate a little and kept the rest in the refrigerator. The next morning (around 6 AM), when I took it out, the food had a strong spoiled smell — clearly indicating it wasn’t fresh or properly prepared.
To make things worse, the restaurant had sent the bill written on a piece of paper instead of a proper printed invoice, which also had a foul smell.
Since one of my family members had liked the dish earlier, I decided to give the restaurant another try. I called to order again and spoke to Mr. Shabbir Hussain. When I politely shared my previous experience, instead of listening, he rudely said, “3 hours main khatam karna hota hai,” and when I asked if that means we should throw the food if it’s left over, he replied, “Kharab hone ka guarantee hum nahi lete.”
This is unacceptable behaviour from a restaurant representative. As a paying customer, I was simply giving feedback and confirming if the food would be freshly made. Instead, I received rude and dismissive replies.
Also, the restaurant’s attitude about providing bills is unprofessional. A customer should not have to ask for a proper printed bill — it should be given automatically.
I hope the management takes this feedback seriously, ensures food quality and hygiene are maintained, and that staff are trained to handle customers respectfully.TAX AND BILLIING VIOLATION. FOOD SAFETY AND CUSTOMER RIGHTS VIOLATION FOR BILL...0 STAR

featured_reviews.name: anurag kasbe
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Culinary Delight at Janata Lunch Home

Last night, I had the pleasure of dining at Janata Lunch Home, and I must say, it was an experience to remember. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and hospitality, setting the tone for a delightful evening ahead.

The standout dish of the night was the Squid, prepared in authentic South Indian style. The tender, succulent pieces were bursting with flavor, perfectly complemented by the aromatic spices. It was a true gastronomic delight.

Equally impressive was the Surmai Tawa Fry, showcasing the freshest catch expertly cooked to crispy perfection. Each bite was a symphony of flavors, leaving me craving for more.

The Neer Dosa, a traditional coastal delicacy, was a revelation. Its delicate texture and subtle taste provided the ideal canvas for savoring the accompanying dishes.

And who could forget the Prawns Gassi? This coconut-based curry was rich, creamy, and packed with the tantalizing flavors of the sea. It paired beautifully with steamed rice, creating a heavenly combination that left me utterly satisfied.

Not only was the food exceptional, but the service was impeccable. The staff was attentive, knowledgeable, and eager to ensure that every aspect of my dining experience was nothing short of perfect.

In conclusion, Janata Lunch Home exceeded all my expectations with its outstanding food and top-notch service. Whether you're a seafood enthusiast or simply looking to indulge in authentic coastal cuisine, this establishment comes highly recommended. I can't wait to return and explore more of their enticing menu offerings.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing dining experience at Wok Hei, and it truly exceeded expectations. The ambiance is warm, vibrant, and perfect for enjoying authentic Chinese cuisine. From the very beginning, everything felt well-organized and welcoming.
We started with the Chef’s Crab Soup, which was rich, flavorful, and incredibly comforting. The balance of spices and the generous crab content made it stand out, setting a great tone for the meal. It was easily one of the highlights of our visit.
For the main course, we ordered the Chicken Chinese Sizzlers, served piping hot and full of bold flavors. The chicken was tender, the vegetables were fresh, and the sauce complemented the dish perfectly. The sizzling presentation added to the excitement, and the portion size was quite satisfying.
A special mention goes to Shraddha from the staff, who made our experience even better. She was courteous, attentive, and very helpful with recommendations. Her service was prompt and professional, ensuring we were comfortable throughout the meal.
Overall, Wok Hei delivers a fantastic combination of delicious food, great ambiance, and excellent service. It’s a perfect spot for anyone craving quality Chinese food, and I would highly recommend it. Looking forward to visiting again and exploring more from their menu. 🍽️🔥

Overall, we had a fantastic time and would highly recommend Wok Hei to anyone looking for great food and excellent service. We’ll definitely be coming back again!

featured_reviews.name: shripad marathe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Coastal Fusion in Chembur is one of those rare restaurants where everything — from the food to the ambience — just falls into place.

I visited recently and started with their Fish Thali, which came loaded with Bangda, Mandeli, Bombil, and Surmai. The flavors were genuinely homestyle and the freshness of the fish was evident in every bite. After that, the Dhaba Style Chicken brought that earthy, slow-cooked richness that you don't find easily anymore. The Kala Masala Chicken Starter stole the show for me — well-spiced, deeply flavored, and gone before I knew it. There's also a Maharashtrian Veg Platter for vegetarians that doesn't feel like an afterthought.

Dessert was Aamras and Gajar Halwa — both done well, a satisfying end to a great meal.

The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, making it a great choice for families and groups. The service was warm and the whole experience felt very genuine.

Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Maharashtrian and coastal flavors in Chembur.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Decent Ambience and Satisfactory taste however concern is the serving size for the pricing they have put up.
Ordered a bombil fry and Surmai thali.
Bombil fry was priced at Rs 270/- and when it arrived we were surprised with just 3 medium pieces of Bombil. For the price the serving size should be reconsidered
Coming to the Surmai thali which was priced at Rs 450/-
Which had Plain fish curry( no fish) + 2 chapati + 2 Medium pieces of Surmai + Coconut chatni + 1 Javla curry with bottle gourd + Solkadi + Rice and our surprising guest a mix vegetable sabji.
Who puts a bottle gourd(dudhi bhopla with fish(Javla curry) and what is mix vegetable Sabji doing in fish thali.

Utterly disappointed with the serving size and quantity.

Hope the restaurant owners consider this feedback and work on it.

featured_reviews.name: Live Delight with Pallavi
featured_reviews.review_text:
The food over here is magical, One of my Favourite restaurant in Mumbai..i also go there where i go to chembur..non veg food is best..i tried their kaleji masala, mori masala and fry, chicken butter masala, naan, sweet lime soda, bangda fry & Prawns masala.
Both A/C & Non A/C are available..alcohol is also served.

featured_reviews.name: Jo Kadantot
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place has lost its past glory.
I came 5-6 years ago, and there were more options in drinks and better portion sizes and taste.

I ordered a chicken tandoori (half), and it was a tiny chicken that didn't have any salt and frankly lacked any decent flavour.
And its price? 300 Rs!

The waiter were also very unenthusiastic, struggled to give recommendations and had a casual attitude (didn't seem trained at all).

I didn't even bother ordering anything after that.

Not sure if they had a change in management or cooking staff.

Either way, I don't think the ownership cares!

featured_reviews.name: Pulastya Dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent joint for seafood as well as chicken and mutton dishes from the konkan region.
Ordered the mutton suke & chicken tawa masala which was really fiery!
Recommended for those who like spicy food.
Ambience is strictly okay and so is the seating. Usually full due meal hours so go a little early.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food quality was very poor and the service was bad.
In the fish thali, only one small piece (tukda) of fish was served along with gravy and a vegetable sabji.
There was no taste at all, and the overall experience was very disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Shri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was a great fan of this restaurant. I ordered for chicken sukka.
Food was smelling bad. They sent stail food.
Really disappointed with the food.

Feedback: Please check the quality of food or you will lose customer

Quality of the food: 0

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Gurav
featured_reviews.review_text: This has been one of my worst restaurant experiences. The food was cold and of poor quality, and the manager did not respond appropriately when I raised a complaint.

featured_reviews.name: Shrikant Mayekar
featured_reviews.review_text: We tried their tawa masala prawns and Schezwan fried rice. Prawns tawa masala was super tasty and spicy, Schezwan fried rice was also good. They serve good portions at reasonable prices. The ambiance was also comfortable..We loved the place. We actually wanted to try the thali but it is available only in the afternoon. We look forward to trying their other varieties.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavya Bhat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Malhaar Restaurant and Bar was a great experience, everything we tried was genuinely good.

We had Crab Lollipop, Prawns Ghee Roast,Neer Dosa, Patra ni Macchi, Bombil Starter, Prawns Biryani, Dal Tadka, Steamed Rice, and Veg Burnt Garlic Noodles, all were 5/5.

For desserts, we tried Mango, Jackfruit, Chikmagalur Coffee (loved this one), and Biscoff Lotus Ice Creams, all were good.

The staff was polite and made the experience smooth.

The staff was polite and made the experience smooth. Overall, a really nice place with great food

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Kanojia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered a takeaway
opting for a Surmai Fish Fry and a Chicken Gravy for the main course. It turned out to be a completely terrible experience.

Surmai Fish Fry: This was completely unacceptable. The fish was distinctly stale and had a foul, off-putting smell. It was clearly not fresh, and we couldn't even take more than a bite because of how bad it was. Serving stale seafood is a major health hazard.

Chicken Gravy: While it wasn't spoiled like the fish, it was horribly bland and completely lacked taste. There was zero flavor or balance in the spices.
For a restaurant that charges full price, serving stale fish and poorly made gravy is highly disappointing. I definitely wouldn't recommend ordering from here if you value fresh food.

featured_reviews.name: Yeshu 999
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently found this place , recommended by a friend . And my oh my what a gem of a place from the valet to food everything is superb , we love it has become our go to place now . Keep up the good work !!

featured_reviews.name: Nishit Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
We normally order from them regularly and have always experienced good and fresh food.
This time we ordered boneless chicken biryani but got one with bone, meat was tough not fresh but moreover we found a bug in the food, big black one after eating a little and that was it for us

featured_reviews.name: Laxmi Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1/5
Extremely Disappointed with the Food Quality

I’m genuinely shocked by today’s experience at Malhaar Restaurant.

I had ordered from Zomato , the Veg Kofta was utterly bizarre and it had tutti frutti and cherries in it! Who puts dessert ingredients in a savoury kofta? It felt to me like the chef got confused between making a sweet dish and a main course. I paid ~₹450 for what tasted like a bland, uninspired dessert -definitely not a proper kofta!

The Hyderabadi Chicken too was devoid of flavour, lacking any authentic taste or spice balance. Overall, both dishes were pathetic and not worth the money.

What’s even more disappointing is that this isn’t the first time the quality has dropped. During our previous visit last month, the Manchow Soup we ordered was also far below expectations : watery, poorly seasoned, and lacking the usual flavour punch we associate with Malhaar. The soup wasn't simmered properly.

We’ve been regular customers and always appreciated the food before, but after today’s experience, I’m seriously skeptical about ever ordering from Malhaar again.

featured_reviews.name: Nived E
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a bad experience at this hotel. We ordered biriyani, but it seems like the food was not fresh or properly handled. Both of us ended up with vomiting and now suffering from loose motion and fever.

Food safety and hygiene should be a top priority, but unfortunately it was not maintained here. Would not recommend this place to others.

Please be careful before ordering from here.

featured_reviews.name: Nilesh Palshetkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Area is slightly crowded so managing car parking could be an issue. Luckily we secured car parking just nearby the restaurant. Ambiance is fine. Sitting arrangement is fine as well. Even after securing the corner seats, we felt that restaurant as somewhat noisy.

Service was alright. Food was good. Chicken lollypop, Chicken manchow soup, Chicken Tandoori masala, Prawns Chilly were up to the mark.

featured_reviews.name: Doveson Cheruvathur
featured_reviews.review_text: The food was good. Nothing to complain about. No excessive oil or anything. Everything perfect. The servers were also well educated about the dishes and suggest good tweaks to the dishes ordered, genuine advice on what it feels like etc etc

featured_reviews.name: Nisha Lakhani
featured_reviews.review_text: I went to this place after reading the reviews... It was such a disappointment.. I ordered a sangria.. which was very bad.. it seems he bartender added the apples to the red wine as an after thought.. when i complained that I am not happy about the drink, the waiter started explaining me how the drink is made.. that they add vodka to it.. on insisting that m not happy with it.. he said I'll get it made again.. he brought another drink after 20 minutes in which there was just more apples... I didn't push.. I had ordered butter garlic prawns.. the dish looked like "mush"... It looked visually non appealing... the taste was very basic.. i complained.. so after 30 mins I get the same dish again.. we ordered a pizza which was decent.. but m not going to this place again... Although I must say it has an amazing potential to be good.. but I think they need lessons in running a restaurant..

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Sen
featured_reviews.review_text:
Grey Cravings – Dinner Review ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆

Visited Grey Cravings with family for dinner, and overall, it was a really good experience. Here's what we tried:

Roasted Lamb Chilly – Absolutely amazing! The mutton was perfectly cooked, soft, and flavorful. 5/5 🏆

Korean Fried Chicken – Decent taste, crispy but could have been better. 3.5/5

Butter Garlic Prawns – Delicious and packed with flavor, one of the highlights of the night. 4.5/5

Mac & Cheese Pasta – Creamy and decent, but nothing exceptional. 3.5/5

Chicken Biryani – Nicely spiced and quite good. 4/5

The ambience was decent and comfortable. Around 11 PM, they start playing the DJ, and it does get a bit loud, so better suited for those who enjoy a lively vibe at night.

Food: 4.5/5 🍽️
Service: 4.5/5 🤝
Ambience: 3.5/5 🎶
Overall: 4/5 ⭐

featured_reviews.name: Vighnesh Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
My first visit to Grey Cravings & it is good decent place. The ambience is good where in they have Indoor/outdoor seating options.

As I visited it on a weekend, they had live music event planned with a DJ.

Food wise, we ordered man-chow soup, peri peri fries, Chinese platter in starter & a paneer biryani. Except the Chinese platter the food was delicious as in the Chinese platter it didn’t that great as expected but a decent one with huge quantity. The quantity is really good for all the dishes. The Biryani easily served 3 people after all the starters we had.

The Chinese starter was mix of Manchurian, veg crispy, paneer chilly & veg lollipop.

The service seemed a little slow but the staff were good.

Overall a good place.

featured_reviews.name: Aniket Ankam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went here for our office dinner party. The ambience is pretty good and welcoming.
We have ordered many things veg and non-veg.
I being vegetarian that day had chilli garlic Lotus stem, kasundi broccoli, hummus bowl, corn daikon balls, cheese balls and peri peri fries. The broccoli was literally half-cooked and very hard to eat, and the corn daikon balls were a disappointment, the rest of the starters were okay.
We ordered pizza which was nice too.
They need to improve a little bit in terms of the taste of the food and the service as it was way slower than the required.
Later we enjoyed the music from both the DJ and the orchestra.

featured_reviews.name: anagha sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text: Chembur has my heart & I personally loved this place because of the spacious seating they offer. They have huge outdoor and indoor area and is a perfect place for groups to chill and hangout together. They serve a variety of dishes and I must say their quality and quantity both will surprise you. We tried both their veg and non veg options and were fully content. Also, the drinks offered were quite refreshing and visually pleasing. All in all this is a perfect place in terms of good food, beautiful ambience and a warm vibe.

featured_reviews.name: Adarsh Rajeshirke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Guys, it’s honestly a waste… the place is not worth it at all. The service is extremely slow — you have to wait at least 30 minutes for your order. The staff isn’t trained properly, and they didn’t even seem ready to serve. I saw only 3 people working there.

We ordered bamboo rice, and it was basically just fried rice with a bad omelette and fried noodles — didn’t make any sense. After waiting around 40 minutes, they came and said there were no eggs for the omelette.

The starters were tasteless — everything had the same flavor, mostly like tomato ketchup. Due to gas shortage, they’ve reduced their menu to about 40%, and no Indian dishes are available. When we tried ordering the main course, they were pushing us to order pizza and pasta instead.

The ambience is good, but what’s the point if the food isn’t worth the price? Don’t go by the hype — it’s genuinely a waste of money.

featured_reviews.review_text: food tastes good , ambience is a bit dull no proper lighting , Ac also was not functioning.
